name: East Midlands Airport
title: East Midlands Airport guide: terminals, airlines and getting there
intro: East Midlands sits between Derby, Nottingham and Leicester, with one terminal. Here's who flies from it and how to get there.

terminals.name: The terminal
terminals.text: One terminal with one security area.

sections.heading: Getting to East Midlands Airport
sections.text:
- **Train and bus:** take the train to East Midlands Parkway, then the Skylink bus to the airport. Skylink buses also run from Derby, Nottingham and Leicester.
- **Car:** the airport is next to junctions 23A and 24 of the M1. There's a charge for the drop-off zone.

faqs.question: Is there a train station at East Midlands Airport?
faqs.answer: No. The nearest is East Midlands Parkway, linked to the airport by the Skylink bus.
